title: Synchronize atlas controls when the frame loop observes reduced motion before its change event
outcome: The frame loop applies the existing reduced-motion transition before it stops if it observes the new preference ahead of the media-change notification.
acceptance: A running atlas switched to prefers-reduced-motion renders final state 3, disables its pause control, and remains visually still.
Returning to no-preference resumes motion unless the user independently paused it.

completion.summary: The frame loop now invokes the existing reduced-motion transition before stopping if it observes the preference before the media-change callback. Independent consultation confirmed this preserves user pause intent and is safe if the event later arrives.
